question: Will XRP close above $1.10 on August 6?

model.prompt_context: Resolves YES if the CoinGecko closing price of XRP for August 6, 2026, as shown in the "Close" column of the CoinGecko XRP Price History page (coingecko.com/en/coins/xrp/historical_data) for the row dated 2026-08-06, is strictly greater than $1.10. A close of exactly $1.10 or below resolves NO.
